role: Conservative source-only two ordinary family bridge proposal; data only

additions: @angular/material as mat; public checkbox-overrides and button-overrides only
owned_value_dependencies: Owned MDC theme-color, typography, ripple, elevation, density and touch-target source
forbidden: Modern component or ordinary DOM fork

color.default_role: Existing root/current-selector color map uses owned accent; mat-accent and no-color host inherit it.
color.primary: Existing mat-primary remaps a new accent key to owned primary without mutating caller map.
color.warn: Existing mat-warn remaps a new accent key to owned warn without mutating caller map.
color.selected: Owned accent-selected color and its own contrast tone feed selected icon/checkmark/focus/hover/pressed tokens; palette default separately feeds selected state layers.
color.unselected: Owned foreground.base opacity0.54 border, gray900/light or gray200/dark focus/hover border, foreground.base state layer.
color.disabled: Owned foreground.base opacity0.38 selected/unselected icons; owned white disabled selected checkmark; owned foreground.disabled-text label.
color.label: Within existing owned MDC theme wrapper, text-primary-on-background exact value; no replacement with merely similarly named foreground.text.
color.state_layer_opacity: Owned fixed0.04 hover and0.16 focus/press for selected/unselected; values remain distinct from button opacities.

unsupported_slot.name: unselected-pressed-icon-color
unsupported_slot.meaning: Current hover/focus icon rules may remain effective during combined pressed states. Value equality with normal is not proof of historical state parity.
unsupported_slot.decision: Preserve current component structural state behavior through public APIs; explicitly document unsupported historical slot and test combined current states. No selector/private-symbol workaround.

selected_pressed_icon.meaning: Emit supported owned value without claiming current runtime consumes this otherwise unused slot.

typography.source: Inside unchanged using-mdc-typography wrapper: map.get(owned mdc-typography.$styles, body2)
typography.raw_and_null: Retain existing 2014/2018 conversion, raw config behavior and wrapper defaults; empty original MDC typography getter remains unchanged.

density.touch: Owned48px size; block by default, existing if-touch-targets-unsupported wrapper adds none.
density.edges: Retain existing clamp min/max/default, out-of-range and fractional semantics; fractional lookup may omit state-layer size and needs explicit expected-emission test.

checkbox.theme_from_tokens: Body remains byte-identical. Existing intentionally incomplete frozen private token boundary is preserved.

roles.unthemed: text/outlined label on-surface; filled/protected label on-surface over surface.
roles.primary: text/outlined primary; filled/protected on-primary over primary.
roles.accent: text/outlined secondary; filled/protected on-secondary over secondary.
roles.warn: text/outlined error; filled/protected on-error over error.

disabled.ink: Exact owned on-surface opacity0.38 light/0.5 dark
disabled.scope: Add per-variant disabled tokens at existing variant roots for current disabled classes/disabledInteractive. Retain and append inside original [disabled][disabled] branches for enabled+disabled token coverage of anchors and buttons.
disabled.runtime: Current peer retains disabled/ripple suppression; no API/input/config equivalence or lifetime fork is assumed.

ripple_and_state.color: Copy exact owned private ripple color rules: base on-surface; text/outlined role color; filled/protected on-role contrast color.
ripple_and_state.ripple: rgba(exact owned color,0.1), distinct from persistent state-layer color.
ripple_and_state.scope: Exactly four historical variants; inherited current selectors consume public state tokens. No tonal/progress-indicator API mirror.

elevation.source: Owned MDC elevation-box-shadow(number), not a numeric token alias.
elevation.scope: Protected variant only; original numeric MDC declarations remain unchanged. Added public shadow tokens use actual owned shadow strings.

typography.source: Inside unchanged owned typography wrapper, owned styles.button
typography.line_height: No stable public button label-line-height key exists at either minimum. Existing direct .mdc-button line-height declaration stays; current host retains mdc-button. Validate computed line-height rather than inventing a key.
typography.raw_and_null: Retain owned raw typography conversion, wrapper default/null behavior and text-transform semantics.

density.touch: Owned48px; same existing unsupported-density helper decides none.
density.edges: Retain old range errors at +1/-4 and owned fractional interpolation/min/max/default. Do not substitute modern40px baseline or modern clamp.

callers.ordinary: Eight finite root exports, ordinary all-component theme/typography/density callsites, plus latent datepicker-legacy-compat ordinary button import.
callers.legacy: Legacy aggregates and legacy datepicker use their separate owned legacy modules; no all-legacy/companion wiring changes proposed.
callers.cyph: Read-only six legacy checkbox/button calls; no ordinary component consumer call was found.

successor_boundary.actual_source_authority: Held. Parent finite four-product source-successor worksheet is prerequisite before application.
successor_boundary.frozen_two_path_subject: Unchanged and retained as historical evidence. Its authenticated284 unchanged-owned members include these proposed targets, so running it against changed product files must reject.
successor_boundary.future: A separately bounded four-target current subject must independently authenticate before/current four module identities, exact positioned additions and complete current loaded graph; preserve original two-module evidence and reject every other changed owned member. Old product bytes remain comparison-only, never current read.
successor_boundary.current_gate_scope: Current gate/source helpers and all CSS models unchanged by this proposal.
